prototype_scale: median norm of original target head rows; fixed before evaluation
teacher_access: Reuse the already validated 256 hard labels per teacher from query_parent, identical to the partial-reset gate. Zero new teacher queries.
student: Public anchor plus the other seven experts at .2. No released target expert parameter enters the student. The prototype projection is compiled into a public anchor copy.
scope: Whole-expert omission control for the same fixed hard-label prototype primitive. No new defense or parameter search. Native target and four fusion tests, matched original/protected controls. Comparisons reset_change and score_recovery_change explicitly refer to the historical partial-reset benchmark, not a whole-omission baseline. Previously inspected tests; no eight-task mean or Table6 claim.
